title: CorpID Capacity Management Updates
changes: Backend updates to prevent exceeding tenant limit of Corporate Identifiers.
Added a failed status to stop continuous retries on devices that repeatedly fail to sync.
Stopped allowing duplicate serial number entries for non-Windows devices. If you have duplicates, remove all and add back the correct entry.
Fixed a bug where preferred hostname regex validation wasn't executing in all cases.
Regular updates for security and hygiene.

title: Security Fix - Device Tag Access
changes: Fixed a security issue on the Devices screen that could allow a user to view devices outside their tags. May also address issues where tag was not displayed in search results.

title: Duplicate Hostname Prevention
changes: Added logic to prevent users from re-using the same preferred hostname across multiple devices. Past duplicates may still exist.

title: Logging & Telemetry Improvements
changes: Improved logging and telemetry to capture more detailed information for troubleshooting and performance monitoring.

title: Implemented Preferred Hostname format validation by tag
changes: Enhancing the system-wide Preferred Hostname validation requirement with tag-specific requirements.

title: Intune Autopilot 2.0 Support
changes: Added ability to enable syncing of devices to the Intune Corporate Identifiers list at tag level.
New state field related to CorpID sync status.

Added a new OS field to support future use of MacOS, iOS, and Android devices. (Currently experimental.)  All devices previously entered are processed will show an OS of Unknown, but will be treated as Windows devices.
Added new Preferred Hostname field to support device naming on enrollment in support of Intune Autopilot 2.0.
Improved the devices screen and search capabilities.
Regular updates for security and hygiene.
